competitors.title: Clerk vs Auth0 vs WorkOS vs Stytch: 2026 Auth Comparison
key_points: Auth pricing comparison across 4 MAU brackets (1K, 10K, 100K, 1M) showing WorkOS free up to 1M MAU, Clerk ~$19,825/mo at 1M, Auth0 five-figure at 1M
SSO/SCIM cost cliff: Clerk $50/connection (metered Feb 2026), WorkOS $125/conn (volume to $65), Stytch ~$100/conn (5 free on B2B tier)
Developer experience ranked: Clerk best-in-class React components, WorkOS AuthKit caught up, Stytch more code required, Auth0 legacy sprawl
Passkeys maturity: Stytch > Clerk ≈ WorkOS > Auth0 for WebAuthn depth
B2B multi-tenancy: WorkOS built for it with self-serve IT admin portal; Clerk B2B suite caught up; Auth0 Organizations works but grafted on
Migration cost: Auth0→WorkOS 2-4 weeks, Auth0→Clerk 1-3 weeks, Firebase→Stytch 1-2 weeks
Lock-in risk: WorkOS most OIDC-standard, Clerk session model most proprietary
Verdict: WorkOS for B2B mid-market/enterprise, Clerk for B2C shipping fast, Stytch for passwordless-first, Auth0 when customer demands it
